en.title: Discount Events (DoorDash #4)
en.description: This problem has the same operation semantics as DoorDash #1 Adjust Prices; it keeps the original number #4 and its company tag. Operation 1 x v sets item x to v; operation 2 v v raises the prices below v to v. The original example is kept as public example 1, and this site adds two more examples. The source gives no constraints or standard input format; the bounds and input protocol explicitly listed on the page are all CSWork supplements.
en.input: The first line contains n q, the second line contains n initial prices, and each of the next q lines contains three integers. Operation 1 x v is a point assignment; operation 2 v v is a global lower bound (the third v is repeated per the source format). CSWork-supplemented ranges: 1≤n,q≤100000, and all prices and v are in 1..10^9; indices start from 1.
en.output: Output the n prices after executing all operations in order.
en.explanation: The editorial is written separately for this number and its original example; see the accompanying editorial.
